**Finding: deviation** (Article XV, ¶¶ p0691–p0711; Article IX supply provisions).

**What I found**
- §15.1/15.2 give only Effective-Date representations (corporate authority, IP title/no conflicting grants, no litigation, patent list accuracy, past GLP/GCP compliance) and §15.3 gives forward covenants (no debarment, no fraudulent statements, anti-bribery).
- Nothing warrants that Array's ongoing performance will meet professional/industry standards, and nothing warrants that Materials supplied under Article 9 will conform to specifications or GMP. Article 9 defers specifications and delivery terms to supply/quality agreements "to be entered into" — a promise to negotiate, not a warranty.
- No repair/replace/refund (or re-perform) remedy exists anywhere; searches for "conform", "cGMP" and "specifications" returned nothing warranty-like.
- §15.4 then disclaims all implied warranties including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose, so Ono effectively takes supplied Materials "as is" — the rule's walk-away scenario, and short of even the 90-day fallback.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)**
- New §15.4 Performance and Product Warranty: professional/workmanlike performance in compliance with applicable Law and GMP; Materials conform in all material respects to specifications, GMP-manufactured, not adulterated/misbranded; no malicious code; remedy of re-performance, replacement or refund on 90 days' notice (90 days from discovery for latent defects), without limiting other remedies.
- §15.4 disclaimer renumbered to §15.5. No express-warranty carve-out was needed because the disclaimer already opens with "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement."
